# clavis rotation status

<p class="cli-lead">Show managed and stale manual-rotation secrets</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis rotation status [flags]
```

</div>

Show which secrets are rotated automatically, which aren't, and which haven't changed for a long time.

## Examples

```sh
clavis rotation status
clavis rotation status --stale-days 60
```

## Flags

<dl class="cli-flags">
<div class="cli-flag" id="flag-stale-days"><dt><code>--stale-days int</code></dt><dd>warn after this many days without rotation <span class="cli-default">Default: <code>90</code></span></dd></div>
</dl>
